AdapterInfo.description: Capture-adapter identity recorded in a manifest.

CaptureDurationConfig.description: Capture duration or record-count limits requested from the adapter.

observation_limit.description: Requested observation-count limit when capture is count bounded.

CaptureFilterConfig.description: One explicit adapter filter applied to the capture source.

enabled.description: Whether this filter was enabled for the capture.

parameters.description: Bounded authoritative adapter parameters for this filter.

CaptureInstrumentationConfig.description: Target instrumentation method and independently measured incremental cost.

method.description: Versioned target-side API or marker method, such as `t32perf-c-wire/v1`.

overhead.description: Controlled measurement used to quantify incremental instrumentation cost.

CaptureInstrumentationOverhead.description:
One controlled measurement of target-side instrumentation overhead.

The incremental cost is `instrumented_duration_ns - baseline_duration_ns`.
Keeping both source durations and the emitted-event count avoids a rounded
floating-point average in the authoritative contract.

baseline_duration_ns.description: Duration of the uninstrumented reference workload.

emitted_event_count.description: Number of target events emitted during the instrumented workload.

evidence_artifact_id.description: Immutable artifact containing raw measurement evidence.

instrumented_duration_ns.description: Duration of the same workload with instrumentation enabled.

CaptureRtosAwarenessConfig.description: RTOS-awareness configuration and its immutable metadata dependencies.

kind.description: Adapter-defined RTOS-awareness kind, such as `none` or a versioned decoder identity.

metadata_artifact_ids.description: Immutable Session artifacts used as RTOS metadata.

CaptureSinkConfig.description: Trace sink configured by the capture adapter.

capacity_bytes.description: Configured sink capacity when the sink is bounded.

id.description: Stable sink identity within the adapter deployment.

stream_destination_identity.description: Stable destination identity for streaming sinks; never contains credentials.

CaptureTimestampConfig.description: Timestamp configuration applied by the capture adapter.

clock_id.description: Clock-domain identifier used by those timestamps.

CaptureTriggerConfig.description: Trigger configuration applied by the capture adapter.

condition_identity.description: Stable identity of an adapter-owned trigger condition.

InitialTargetState.description: Target execution state at the instant capture configuration became authoritative.

oneOf.description: The adapter could not establish the target state.

description: Authoritative, language-neutral capture configuration recorded before normalization.

adapter.description: Versioned adapter responsible for applying the configuration.

adapter_parameters.description: Bounded authoritative parameters not represented by the common contract.

filters.description: Explicit bounded filters applied by the adapter.

initial_target_state.description: Initial target execution state observed by the adapter.

instrumentation.description: Target custom-event instrumentation and measured overhead, when used.

provider.description: Capture provider responsible for applying the configuration.

session_id.description: Session that owns this configuration and its resulting artifacts.

workload_identity.description: Stable workload identity executed during capture.
